none: PAS NLM-CB12D2: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, possibly Constantius II (323-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TANT[--]AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths over an indistinct object, possibly altar or column. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this worn coin. Diameter: 15.5mm, Weight: 1.29gms, die axis: 12
